name: The Boardwalk
lede: At The Boardwalk, a two-acre courtyard extends the office outdoors for meetings, focused work and lunch. Platinum Electric heaters built into its pergolas keep it in use through the cooler months.
data: Office campus – two-acre courtyard with pergolas

hero.caption: Platinum Electric on a pergola beam above a long table. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Managed by CBRE, The Boardwalk is a luxury office complex in Irvine with resort-style outdoor space: a two-acre courtyard with pergolas, an onsite restaurant and a café.
The aim was flexible outdoor space for meetings, brainstorming, focused work and dining, with heating that looks good and works, so the courtyard is used all year.

Platinum Smart-Heat Electric heaters were installed within the courtyard’s pergolas on Platinum Electric mounting poles, their stainless steel chassis and tinted ceramic glass suiting the resort-style design.
